summary: Geopolitical uncertainty around the US-Iran standoff and a hawkish Fed are the twin anchors weighing on risk sentiment. Bonds are catching a safe-haven bid as TLT rallies, while crypto remains deep in fear — down roughly 50% from its October 2025 peak — battered by ETF outflows and fading rate-cut expectations. Quarter-end rebalancing is adding noise to equity breadth, which is holding up even as gold slides.
tweet: US-Iran tensions and a Fed locked into a hawkish hold are splitting markets: bonds rally, crypto stays crushed, stocks rotate under the surface as payrolls loom Thursday.
